C0975.title: League of Legends to Introduce Surrender Vote for Intentional Feeding
C0975.summary: League of Legends plans to launch a new feature in 2026 that allows teammates to vote to end a match early when the system detects intentional feeding. The offending player will face penalties, while the remaining teammates will not lose rank, aiming to reduce the impact of disruptive behavior on the game experience.
